BRICS Cultural Summit Held in Bhopal

The BRICS Cultural Summit took place in Bhopal from August 5th to August 8th. Representatives from several countries participated in the event. Foreign artists presented cultural performances. The summit featured three exhibitions showcasing India's cultural heritage. On August 7th and 9th, the exhibitions were open to the public.
